headline: Summer Is On! Flexible Payments Help Consumers Keep It That Way
summary: Summer spending is heating up, but consumers are keeping their cool by planning ahead and leaning into financing flexibility. Synchrony (NYSE: SYF), a leading consumer financing company, today released new insights from its latest In Sync with Consumers survey, showing flexible payment options are helping people participate in summer activities and experiences while keeping budgets on track.
